_help: Quiz for What If You Invested $100. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: Why can $100 in crypto turn into $20 before it turns into $500?
options: Crypto prices swing a lot, up and down
questions.answer: Crypto prices swing a lot, up and down
questions.explain: Big gains in hindsight usually came with big drops along the way.

questions.question: What does a drawdown measure?
options: How far the price fell from its highest point
questions.answer: How far the price fell from its highest point
questions.explain: A 70% drawdown means the price fell to 30% of its peak.

questions.question: What is the danger of looking only at the start and end price?
options: You miss how hard the ride was in between
questions.answer: You miss how hard the ride was in between
questions.explain: Most people sell in the scary drops, so they never get the end result.

questions.question: What is dollar cost averaging?
options: Buying a small fixed amount on a regular schedule
Buying everything at once at the top
questions.answer: Buying a small fixed amount on a regular schedule
questions.explain: It spreads your buys over time, so one bad day matters less.

questions.question: Past returns tell you...
options: What happened, not what will happen
That the price will double again
questions.answer: What happened, not what will happen
questions.explain: A coin that went up 100 times may never do it again.

questions.question: What is a sensible amount to put into a risky asset?
options: Only what you can afford to lose
questions.answer: Only what you can afford to lose
questions.explain: Keep your safety money safe, then take small risks with the rest.
